'''Wolfgang Konrad Spohn''' (born 20 March 1950, in [[Tübingen]]) is a German philosopher.<ref>{{cite web |title=Spohn, Wolfgang, 1950-.... |url=https://viaf.org/viaf/14828360/ |website=[[VIAF|Virtual International Authority File]] |publisher=OCLC |access-date=12 July 2026}}</ref> He is professor emeritus of philosophy and [[philosophy of science]] at the [[University of Konstanz]].<ref>{{cite web
 |title=Prof. Dr. Wolfgang Spohn
 |url=https://www.philosophie.uni-konstanz.de/en/spohn/professors/professor-first-and-last-name/
 |website=Department of Philosophy, University of Konstanz
 |publisher=University of Konstanz
 |access-date=12 July 2026
}}</ref>

== Biography ==

Wolfgang Spohn studied philosophy, [[logic]] and philosophy of science and mathematics at [[LMU Munich]] and acquired there the [[Magister (degree)|MA]] (1973) and the PhD (1976) with a thesis on the ''Grundlagen der Entscheidungstheorie''.<ref name="uni_tuebingen">{{cite web
 |title=Prof. Dr. Wolfgang Spohn
 |url=https://uni-tuebingen.de/fakultaeten/philosophische-fakultaet/fachbereiche/philosophie-rhetorik-medien/philosophisches-seminar/personen/privatdozentinnen-und-affiliierte-professoreninnen/prof-dr-wolfgang-spohn/
 |website=University of Tübingen
 |access-date=12 July 2026
}}</ref><ref name="ae_info">{{cite web |title=Spohn Wolfgang |url=https://www.ae-info.org/ae/Member/Spohn_Wolfgang |website=Academia Europaea |access-date=12 July 2026}}</ref> In his time as an assistant professor, he earned the [[habilitation]] (1984) with a thesis about ''Eine Theorie der Kausalität''.<ref name="ae_info" /> He held professorships at the [[University of Regensburg]] (1986–91), [[Bielefeld University]] (1991–96), and the University of Konstanz (1996–2018).<ref name="uni_tuebingen" /> From 2019 to 2025, he was a senior professor at the [[University of Tübingen]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Seniorprofessor an der Universität Tübingen |url=https://www.uni-konstanz.de/en/university/news-and-media/current-announcements/news-in-detail/seniorprofessor-an-der-universitaet-tuebingen/ |website=Universität Konstanz |date=21 March 2019 |access-date=12 July 2026 |language=de}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Seniorprofessur |url=https://uni-tuebingen.de/forschung/forschungsschwerpunkte/exzellenzcluster-maschinelles-lernen/forschung/forschung/cluster-arbeitsgruppen/professuren/ |website=Universität Tübingen |access-date=12 July 2026 |language=de}}</ref>

Spohn is editor of the philosophical journal ''[[Erkenntnis]]'' and was its editor-in-chief from 1988 to 2001.<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Rott |first1=Hans |last2=Leitgeb |first2=Hannes |title=Editorial |journal=Erkenntnis |volume=75 |issue=1 |pages=1–3 |date=23 June 2011 |doi=10.1007/s10670-011-9302-2 |issn=1572-8420}}</ref>
<ref>{{cite web |title=Editors |url=https://link.springer.com/journal/10670/editors |website=Erkenntnis, Springer |access-date=12 July 2026}}</ref> He is a founding member of the ''Gesellschaft für Analytische Philosophie'' and was its vice-president from 2006 to 2012.<ref>{{cite web |title=Curriculum Vitae Professor Dr. Wolfgang Spohn |url=https://www.leopoldina.org/fileadmin/Altsystem/redaktion/Mitglieder/CV_Spohn_Wolfgang-D.pdf |website=Nationale Akademie der Wissenschaften Leopoldina |access-date=12 July 2026 |language=de}}</ref> He was a Fellow at the ''[[Institute for Advanced Study, Berlin|Wissenschaftskolleg zu Berlin]]'' (1985/86) and a [[Distinguished Visiting Professor]] at the [[University of California, Irvine]] (1988).<ref name="ae_info" /> Since 2002, he is a member of the ''[[German Academy of Sciences Leopoldina|Deutsche Akademie der Naturforscher Leopoldina]]''<ref name="v187">{{cite web | title=Mitglieder | website=Nationale Akademie der Wissenschaften Leopoldina | date=29 June 2023 | url=https://www.leopoldina.org/mitgliederverzeichnis/mitglieder/member/Member/show/wolfgang-spohn/ | language=de | access-date=22 August 2024}}</ref> and since 2015 a member of the [[Academia Europaea]]<ref name="ae_info" />. In 2012, he was the first outside Anglosaxon academia to win the ''[[Lakatos Award]]'' of the [[London School of Economics]] for his book ''The Laws of Belief. Ranking Theory and its Philosophical Applications''.<ref>{{cite web |title=Lakatos Award Winners |url=https://www.lse.ac.uk/philosophy/events/lakatos-award-lecture |website=London School of Economics and Political Science, Department of Philosophy, Logic and Scientific Method |access-date=12 July 2026}}</ref> In 2015, he received the Frege Prize of the ''Gesellschaft für Analytische Philosophie'' for outstanding achievements of a German-speaking philosopher in the field of analytic philosophy.<ref>{{cite web |title=Mitteilungen |url=https://gap-im-netz.de/de/mitteilungen.html |website=Gesellschaft für Analytische Philosophie e.V. |access-date=12 July 2026 |language=de}}</ref><ref name="ae_info" /> In 2023, he received an honorary doctorate from [[LMU Munich]].<ref name="lmu_honorary_doctorate">{{cite web | url=https://www.philosophie.lmu.de/de/aktuelles/newsuebersicht/news/verleihung-der-ehrendoktorwuerde-an-prof.-wolfgang-spohn-konstanz.html | title=Verleihung der Ehrendoktorwürde an Prof. Wolfgang Spohn (Konstanz) }}</ref>

Spohn was speaker of two [[German Research Foundation|DFG]] Research Units ''Logic in Philosophy'' (1997–2003) and ''What if?'' (2012–2018), PI of the Collaborative Research Center 471 Variation in the Lexicon (2000–2008) und co-initiator of the DFG Priority Program SPP 1516 New Frameworks of Rationality (2011–2018), from which the interdisciplinary, philosophical-psychological Handbook of Rationality (MIT Press 2021), co-edited with Markus Knauff, emerged. He was a member of the Excellence Cluster EXC 2064 Machine Learning: New Perspectives for Science from 2019 to 2025, and since 2020 he has been directing his [[Reinhart Koselleck]] Project Reflexive Decision and Game Theory.<ref name="exc2064_alumni">{{cite web |title=Alumni |url=https://uni-tuebingen.de/en/research/core-research/cluster-of-excellence-machine-learning/people/team/alumni/ |website=Cluster of Excellence – Machine Learning for Science, University of Tübingen |access-date=12 July 2026}}</ref><ref name="koselleck_konstanz">{{cite web |title=Reflexive Decision & Game Theory |url=https://www.philosophie.uni-konstanz.de/forschung/drittmittelprojekte/reinhart-koselleck-projekt/ |website=Fachbereich Philosophie, Universität Konstanz |access-date=12 July 2026}}</ref>

Spohn is the youngest brother of the historical sociologist {{ill|Willfried Spohn|de}} and of the mathematical physicist [[Herbert Spohn]].

== Research ==

Spohn's work is particularly associated with his contributions to formal [[epistemology]], in particular for comprehensively developing ranking theory<ref name="laws_of_belief">{{cite book | last=Spohn | first=Wolfgang | title=The Laws of Belief | publisher=Oxford University Press | date=29 March 2012 | isbn=978-0-19-969750-2 | doi=10.1093/acprof:oso/9780199697502.001.0001 | page=}}</ref> since 1982, which is his theory of the dynamics of belief.<ref name="lmu_honorary_doctorate" /> It is an alternative to [[probability theory]] and has similarly great philosophical significance for many related epistemological topics (such as the problem of induction and the [[Causality|theory of causation]]). Spohn's research extends to [[philosophy of science]], [[metaphysics]] and [[ontology]], [[philosophy of language]] and [[Philosophy of mind|mind]], [[Two-dimensionalism|two-dimensional semantics]], [[philosophical logic]], and [[Decision theory|decision]] and [[game theory]] (see the collection of papers<ref name="Spohn 2008 p. ">{{cite book | last=Spohn | first=W. | title=Causation, Coherence and Concepts | publisher=Springer Science & Business Media | date=14 November 2008 | isbn=978-1-4020-5474-7 | page=}}</ref>). His dissertation<ref>''Grundlagen der Entscheidungstheorie'', Scriptor, Kronberg/Ts. 1978; PDF version :  http://www.uni-konstanz.de/FuF/Philo/Philosophie/files/grundlagen_der_entscheidungstheorie.pdf</ref> and his paper "Stochastic Independence, Causal Independence, and Shieldability"<ref name="Spohn 1980 pp. 73–99">{{cite journal | last=Spohn | first=Wolfgang | title=Stochastic independence, causal independence, and shieldability | journal=Journal of Philosophical Logic | publisher=Springer Science and Business Media LLC | volume=9 | issue=1 | year=1980 | issn=0022-3611 | doi=10.1007/bf00258078 | pages=73–99| s2cid=206773131 | url=http://nbn-resolving.de/urn:nbn:de:bsz:352-136744 }}</ref> are precursors of the theory of [[Bayesian network|Bayesian networks]] and their causal interpretation, which became the dominating statistical theory of causality after 1990.<ref>{{cite journal |last=Pearl |first=Judea |title=Graphoids over Counterfactuals |journal=Journal of Causal Inference |volume=2 |issue=2 |pages=243–248 |year=2014 |doi=10.1515/jci-2014-0028}}</ref> His paper ''How to Make Sense of Game Theory''<ref name="Spohn 1982 pp. 239–270">{{cite book | last=Spohn | first=Wolfgang | title=Philosophy of Economics | chapter=How to make Sense of Game Theory | series=Studies in Contemporary Economics | publisher=Springer Berlin Heidelberg | publication-place=Berlin, Heidelberg | year=1982 | volume=2 | isbn=978-3-540-11927-2 | issn=1431-8806 | doi=10.1007/978-3-642-68820-1_14 | pages=239–270 | s2cid=16780370 | chapter-url=http://nbn-resolving.de/urn:nbn:de:bsz:352-136710 }} reprinted in: {{cite book | last1=Varoufakis | first1=Yanis | last2=Housego | first2=Anthony | title=Game Theory | publisher=Psychology Press | date=2001 | isbn=978-0-415-22240-2 |pages=213–241}}</ref> is a forerunner of epistemic game theory, which developed into an important branch of game theory.<ref>{{cite book |last=Perea |first=Andrés |chapter=Epistemic Game Theory |editor1-last=Knauff |editor1-first=Markus |editor2-last=Spohn |editor2-first=Wolfgang |title=The Handbook of Rationality |publisher=MIT Press |year=2021 |url=https://epicenter.name/Perea/Papers/EGT.pdf}}</ref> The novel game theoretic concept of a dependency equilibrium, which generalizes the basic notion of a [[Nash equilibrium]], is first introduced in his paper ''Dependency Equilibria and the Causal Structure of Decision and Game Situations''.<ref>{{cite journal |last=Spohn |first=Wolfgang |title=Dependency Equilibria and the Causal Structure of Decision and Game Situations |journal=Homo Oeconomicus |volume=20 |pages=195–255 |year=2003}}</ref>
<ref>{{cite arXiv |last1=Portakal |first1=Irem |last2=Sendra-Arranz |first2=Javier |title=Game theory of undirected graphical models |eprint=2402.13246 |class=math.AG |year=2024}}</ref>
